summary: Iteration 2 testing complete: Admin Content Builder (sidebar + CRUD), role-scoped UI/API, Razorpay settings & webhook security, Google auth stub, All-India Rank. 28/28 pytest cases PASS across backend; frontend admin flows verified via Playwright (sidebar, nav, Settings DEMO→TEST, teacher scoping, student /admin→/dashboard, Google button on login+register). Payment settings reset to demo at end.
passed_backend_tests: /api/admin/stats – admin sees revenue; teacher no revenue; student 403
Initial mode=demo; webhook secret generates & persists; save fake keys→mode=test; blank secret keeps old; test connection with fake keys returns 400 toast
/api/webhooks/razorpay – bad signature 400; valid HMAC-SHA256 marks order paid + grants entitlement
/api/test-series create (price 19900 paise), /api/tests create (total_marks computed), edit test recalculates total_marks, delete series cascades tests
/api/courses + /api/sections + /api/lessons create; GET /courses/{id} nests sections+lessons; delete section cascades lessons
PUT /admin/users/{id}/role – self-change 400; non-super granting super_admin 403; admin changes other user role 200
All-India Rank: 3 submissions produces rank=1 for topper, percentile=100, top list populated
passed_frontend_checks: Admin login → /admin; sidebar renders all 10 testids (sidebar-dashboard/question-bank/test-series/tests/courses/study-materials/categories/users/orders/settings)
Each sidebar link navigates to the correct /admin/* route
Settings page: payment-mode starts as DEMO; Generate webhook secret fills input; Save with fake keys switches to TEST MODE
Teacher login → /admin shows only Overview+Content groups (no categories/users/orders/settings)
Question Bank page lists seeded 10 questions with +New Question btn present
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1086 lines – approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, content, exam, orders, admin, settings).
GoogleSessionIn uses hardcoded Emergent demobackend URL — fine for now but should be env-configurable for prod.
_rank_for recomputes rank for every request; for high traffic, cache per (test_id, user_id) with invalidation on new submits.

/api/webhooks/razorpay returns {'ok': True} after signature verification even if JSON parsing fails; acceptable for Razorpay retry behaviour but silently swallows malformed payloads – consider logging.

/api/content/{kind} PUT reconstructs full model_dump; be aware that fields like created_by/created_at are overwritten by $set only if included – server.py keeps them because they aren't in TestIn/CourseIn models, so they are preserved. OK.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Rank test registered 2 TEST_ students and deleted them after. Payment settings doc deleted at end (app back to demo mode).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts=''`. Pytest.ini contains xdist args that must be overridden. Payment settings are expected to be absent (demo mode) at start of each run; tests themselves manage this. Google OAuth cannot be completed in automation - only button+redirect+401 invalid session verified. Razorpay fake keys produce expected 400 on test connection. All iteration 2 features working as spec'd.
